K1_remainder.a_path_that_is_not_text: `isabs` on an integer raised TypeError out of a validator whose whole job is to turn a bad document into a refusal; every owned path is type-checked first.
K1_remainder.realpath_equality_is_not_containment: comparing RESOLVED paths made `a/state` symlinked to `b/state` compare EQUAL to itself -- both sides resolved to b -- so an unchanged selector dispatched `stop` into another instance. The comparison is now literal string equality against the derived layout AND the derived path must RESOLVE inside the resolved destination.

K2_remainder.a_distro_that_is_itself_a_link: every link INSIDE the bundle was bound and the root was not, so a `distro` that was a name for another tree digested that tree and called it this one. A symlinked root is refused.

K3_remainder.assets_are_the_expected_ones: `schema_assets` was any dict of positive integers, so an empty one or one carrying an arbitrary key passed; it must now be exactly the two frozen assets this distribution ships, each non-empty
K3_remainder.identity_asked_before_any_effect: the identity was asked of the INSTALLED command, so a digestible but unsuitable runtime reached a composed Authority, a created destination and a copied distro before being refused -- leaving all of it behind. `admit` now asks it of the SOURCE command before any effect, and returns the manifest and identity it admitted.
K3_remainder.the_copy_is_re-digested: install refuses if what landed does not digest as what was admitted
K3_remainder.the_native_validator_must_be_the_BUNDLE': `native_rpds` was accepted as any non-empty string, so a build that had imported the HOST's rpds answered perfectly well; the path it names must now resolve inside the bundle's own resources
